v1.meaning: Whether Section 2(b)(1)(A)(i) applies to Bob in 2018 (i.e., Bob qualifies for head of household under that specific provision). This requires: Bob is not married at the close of 2018; Bob maintains a home for more than half the year that is the principal abode of a qualifying child of Bob as defined in section 152(c); and the qualifying child is such that the disqualification condition does not apply (i.e., the child is either not married at year end or, if married, is a dependent of Bob under section 152(b)(2)).
